title: Overland Officer Shoots Suspect During Struggle at a Gas Station
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Overland, Missouri — On March 30, 2025, at approximately 7:45 a.m., an Overland Police officer made an investigative stop in a gas station parking lot in the 10,700 block of Page Avenue. The stop was the result of an alert notifying officers of a white 2015 Chevrolet Sonic, wanted for aggravated battery to a police officer in Caseyville, Illinois. Officers on scene approached the vehicle and ordered a passenger and the driver to exit the vehicle. The passenger complied, the driver however exited the vehicle and attempted to evade the officer. The officer wrestled the driver to the ground. 

During the struggle, the officer fired his service weapon, striking the suspect once in the arm. The suspect was taken into custody and transported to an area hospital for treatment of a non-life-threatening gunshot injury. It was later discovered that the driver had a warrant for a parole violation. On March 31, 2025, the St louis County Prosecuting Attorney's Office issued charges against the suspect, now identified as 28-year-old Eddie Washington, for Resisting or Interfering with an Arrest, Detention, or Stop. He is currently being held on a $5,000, cash only, no 10% bond. The passenger was taken into custody without incident.
